remarks: Rare opportunity to own this Stamford Wellness/Medical/Surgical Pavilion on Summer Street in the heart of Downtown Stamford, CT. This well maintained building is 41,153 square foot and 5 stories on .80 acres of land on 2 lots (1290 Summer St/189 Franklin St). Strategically located just a mile from both Stamford Hospital and Stamford Health Tully Center with easy access from I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Ample on-site covered parking is available with a total of 118 parking spaces (43 exterior spaces, 20 covered spaces and 55 in the parking garage below the building). Most of the rear of the property is dedicated to parking and is an excellent opportunity for additional development. There is vehicle access from both Franklin and Summer Streets. Please note there are flexible spaces available for lease (approx 17K sf) noted in related listing #170518748.
